data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ard was a god of war. The name Ard is derived from the Greek word ‘arados’, meaning ‘manly, man, warrior, or strong’. This name was given to boys born into warrior families or those who showed great courage. The name Ard carries the meaning “Bold, brave, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ard usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, brave, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
